name: McGRATH, the Hon. James

headline.note: Official records establish private legal work in 1996–99 and Queensland Ombudsman investigation work in 1999–2001, followed chiefly by political staff, party and campaign roles that are excluded. McGrath also performed paid self-employed contract work in 2012–14, including for six named organisations after his 2013 election. Published sources do not establish full-time status, hours, leave, exact handovers or a complete client-by-client allocation, so no public/private total is calculated. A separately documented May–June2008 GLA political-adviser consultancy is excluded; exact contract dates do not establish full-time work or last working day.

career_spells.employer: Griffith University and Queensland University of Technology
career_spells.role: Bachelor of Commerce, Bachelor of Laws and Master of Laws student
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography lists BCom and LLB degrees from Griffith University and an LLM from QUT, without attendance dates.
The official parliamentary biography identifies the Queensland firm and a 1996–99 interval encompassing articled-clerk and solicitor work. It does not give exact role boundaries, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: The year range and professional titles do not alone establish a continuous full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives Investigating Officer at the Queensland Parliamentary Ombudsman from 1999 to 2001. Exact appointment and cessation dates, hours, leave and overlap with legal work are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: Government office employment is public, but the evidence does not establish a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Office of a South Australian minister not identified in the official biography
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives Ministerial Adviser (SA) from 2001 to 2002 but does not name the minister, office, exact dates, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.role: Campaign Co-ordinator; Chief of Staff to the Party Chairman; Special Adviser to the Shadow Chancellor; Deputy Campaign Director for the Boris Johnson mayoral campaign; other roles
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography aggregates multiple UK Conservative roles over 2002–08. Contemporary reporting and McGrath's first speech corroborate his Boris Johnson campaign work, but role-specific dates, employers/payroll, hours and gaps are incomplete. Separate post-election GLA consultancy below is not assumed to be party payroll. First speech also describes Tory media-adviser work but no individual dates; existing2002–08 aggregate is not a claim of continuous service in every listed post.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign-organisation roles are excluded.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography identifies the party, role and year but not exact dates, contractual entity, hours or leave.
The official biography gives the Deputy Director role from 2009 to 2010, without exact dates, hours or leave.

The official biography gives a 2010–12 interval. Queensland parliamentary speeches contemporaneously identify McGrath as the LNP state campaign director leading its 2012 election campaign. Exact appointment/cessation, hours and leave are unpublished.

The official biography identifies the role and year; ABC reporting independently identifies McGrath as director of the CLP's 2012 campaign. Exact dates, hours and any overlap with LNP work are unpublished.

career_spells.employer: Self-employed contracting practice; clients included Santos GLNG, KPMG, Pharmacy Guild, National Retail Association, Liberal Party of Australia (NSW Division) and Liberal Party of Australia (WA Division)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives self-employed contracting from 2012 to 2014. McGrath's signed 2014 interests statement identifies paid contract work for the six named clients from his September 2013 election through 30 June 2014. It does not state each assignment's role, start/end, hours, leave, revenue share or whether further 2012–13 clients existed.
career_spells.counting_note: Paid private contracting is supported, but neither the aggregate year range nor the client disclosure establishes full-time service or non-overlapping client intervals. Party-client work would also require exclusion if separable.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary records show election in 2013 and Senate service beginning 1 July 2014.

career_spells.employer: Greater London Authority, Office of Mayor Boris Johnson
career_spells.role: Political adviser / deputy chief of staff, consultancy contract
career_spells.evidence_note: GLA July2008 written answers record a consultancy appointment6May and contract end30June2008, with £19,500 paid for May/June. A23June report announces departure, so contract endpoint is not proof of working through30June. Original six-month contract was curtailed. Personal service entity, hours, leave and last working day unknown; political advisory work excluded.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

research_notes: Obtain Bennett Carroll and Gibbons personnel records or professional directory entries giving articled-clerk/solicitor role boundaries, hours, leave and exact cessation.
Obtain Queensland Ombudsman appointment/cessation records, employment basis, hours and leave; resolve the 1999 boundary with legal practice.
Identify the South Australian minister and employing office and obtain exact 2001–02 dates; political staff remains excluded.
Disaggregate each 2002–08 UK role, employer/payroll, dates, gaps and overlaps, including whether Crosby Textor rather than the Conservative Party employed McGrath for any assignment.
Obtain exact appointment/cessation and paid-hours evidence for Maldivian, Liberal, LNP and CLP roles; party/campaign work remains excluded.
Disaggregate the 2012–14 contracting practice by client, role, date, hours, leave and business entity; separate excluded Liberal Party client work from other private assignments.

Follow-up2026-10-02: primary London Assembly answers recover omitted post-election mayoral consultancy and exact contract dates/payment. Keep it separate from Conservative Party campaign roles. First speech/official party list add Mongolia campaign and early political/student roles. No private/public years calculated.

Targeted legal-firm/admission, Queensland Ombudsman, SA ministerial-office, Conservative role-boundary and Crosby Textor searches did not establish hours, leave, SA minister identity or individual UK party-post dates. Do not infer employers from having worked with named strategists. Namesake US/UK lawyers, academics and corporate officers excluded.
